items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She had a Harlem lover, George Givot. I never seen him no more.

ctx.x: What was the name of the show with Mae West that you were in?

The Constant Sinner. She was supposed to be the sinner for women. She had a Harlem lover, George Givot. I never seen him no more. He’s a handsome Greek. Come to Broadway and they’re going to make a big star out of him. He went from her to Los Angeles, Hollywood. He went there and for some reason . . . he must have married some rich woman . . . he got fed up with Hollywood, and he disappeared. Never heard no more of him. That was a experience there.
What were you playing in that show?
